# `ofac_entity_observations`

**OFAC sanctions entity observations**

Literal OFAC enhanced-export observations with selected-list context and retained source history.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Every entity in each explicitly admitted selected export is retained. Selected SDN and consolidated exports need not share an update time. Prior selected snapshots remain on refresh; absence does not establish delisting, and no history before these captures is inferred. Qualification and public selection are recorded by the generation evidence. *(measured 2026-10-20)*

- **Parquet file:** `ofac_entity_observations.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot_id` | `VARCHAR` | Admitted source-release digest. Captures remain separate even when original content is unchanged. |
| `selected_list` | `VARCHAR` | Explicitly selected sdn or consolidated export; separate from the memberships stated by an entity. |
| `entity_id` | `VARCHAR` | Literal OFAC entity id attribute. Unique within a selected snapshot, not a real-world or cross-list identity. |
| `identity_id` | `VARCHAR` | Literal generalInfo identityId. Distinct from entity_id and preserved as text. |
| `entity_type_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal entityType label, including unknown future values. |
| `entity_type_ref_id` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher reference ID attached to entityType; no cross-source code mapping. |
| `primary_names_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered formattedFullName strings for names and translations explicitly marked primary. Empty array means none supplied under those flags. |
| `names_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered complete names sections with aliases, quality flags, translations, scripts and name parts. |
| `list_memberships_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered literal sanctionsLists sections with membership IDs, reference IDs and dates. |
| `programs_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered literal sanctionsPrograms sections; repeated programs and native IDs remain separate. |
| `sanction_types_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered sanctionsTypes sections such as Block or Reject; no legal effect is inferred. |
| `legal_authorities_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered legalAuthorities sections with source text and native references. |
| `addresses_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered address sections including translations and parts. Sparse addresses remain sparse; no country is invented. |
| `identifiers_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered identityDocuments sections with literal document numbers, issuing countries, types and validity flags. Leading zeros remain. |
| `relationships_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered typed relationship sections including literal related entity IDs and labels. No ownership or cross-list identity inference. |
| `features_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered features sections with source precision and ranges. A year-only birthdate is not converted to a day. |
| `entity_content_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the canonical literal entity tree excluding positional paths. Text, whitespace, order and attributes remain significant. |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Original positional observation identity in the admitted source release, distinct from native entity and identity IDs. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Original request URL, compressed and decoded member digests, capture time, member name and positional XML path. |
| `raw_entity_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete ordered entity tree, including unknown fields, expanded XML names, attributes, namespace declarations and literal text. |
